phase: D18 option (a): worker-process supervision moved into hsk-studio-worker; motion-js, reel-native and score-plugin switched; consumer files no longer hold supervision code

commits.subject: worker: supervision API (Supervisor, Session, RespawnGate, program lookup beside the executable, Job Object caps behind job-caps, typed Classified, heartbeat) with 7 tests
motion-js: supervision, Job Object caps and program lookup moved to the worker crate; windows-sys dropped; WorkerConfig::with_worker_program
reel-native: supervision, respawn gate, program lookup and HELLO wait moved to the worker crate
score-plugin: supervisor.rs removed, host.rs uses the worker crate Supervisor/Session

capabilities_done: hsk-studio-worker: Supervisor/SupervisorConfig/StartRequest (spawn: env_clear + explicit env, null stderr, piped stdio, CREATE_NO_WINDOW), Session (wait with cancel/deadline/CPU-cap polling, send_request, exchange, heartbeat, terminate idempotent, fail -> Classified{Canceled,Deadline,Crashed{exit_code},Protocol(E)}), admission Permit (worker + byte budget), ledger, counters, RespawnGate, resolve_program/find_beside/discover_program (beside the running executable only), optional Windows Job Object caps (feature job-caps, unsafe confined to src/job.rs) and harden_worker_process, overflow-safe deadline arithmetic (after, 24 h clamp)

motion-js: WorkerEngine keeps the QuickJS wire protocol, pool, counters and EngineFailure mapping; OsLimits re-exported from the worker crate; crate is forbid(unsafe_code) in every build; windows-sys removed
reel-native: Pool keeps the AV1 protocol, counters and Av1WorkerFault mapping; reply channel bounded to 1 (reply_buffer) as before; alive stat = Supervisor workers_live
score-plugin: host.rs imports the worker crate API; supervisor.rs deleted
